<?php
/**
 * Binary Message Protocol Handler
 * Protocol: [2-byte version][2-byte type][4-byte payload_length][payload][32-byte HMAC]
 * All multi-byte integers are big-endian unsigned.
 */

class MessageProtocol {
    private string $sharedKey;
    private string $storageDir;
    private array $handlers = [];
    private int $maxPayloadSize;

    public function __construct(string $configPath) {
        $config = json_decode(file_get_contents($configPath), true);
        $this->sharedKey = base64_decode($config['shared_key']);
        $this->storageDir = realpath($config['storage_dir']);
        $this->maxPayloadSize = $config['max_payload_size'] ?? 65536;
        $this->registerDefaultHandlers();
    }

    private function registerDefaultHandlers(): void {
        $this->handlers[1] = [$this, 'handleStore'];
        $this->handlers[2] = [$this, 'handleRetrieve'];
        $this->handlers[3] = [$this, 'handleDelete'];
    }

    /**
     * Parse and validate incoming binary message
     * Returns parsed message array or null on failure
     */
    public function parseMessage(string $raw): ?array {
        // Minimum message size: 2 + 2 + 4 + 0 + 32 = 40 bytes
        if (strlen($raw) < 40) {
            return null;
        }

        // Parse header fields
        $header = unpack('nversion/ntype/Npayload_length', substr($raw, 0, 8));
        if ($header === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $version = $header['version'];
        $type = $header['type'];
        $payloadLength = $header['payload_length'];

        // Version check
        if ($version !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        // Type validation
        if ($type < 1 || $type > 3) {
            return null;
        }

        // Payload length validation
        // Ensure payload_length matches actual remaining data minus HMAC
        $expectedTotal = 8 + $payloadLength + 32;
        if ($expectedTotal !== strlen($raw)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Validate payload size against configured maximum
        if (!$this->validatePayloadSize($payloadLength)) {
            return null;
        }

        // Extract payload and HMAC
        $payload = substr($raw, 8, $payloadLength);
        $hmac = substr($raw, 8 + $payloadLength, 32);

        // Verify HMAC over header + payload
        $dataToVerify = substr($raw, 0, 8 + $payloadLength);
        if (!$this->verifyHmac($dataToVerify, $hmac)) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'version' => $version,
            'type' => $type,
            'payload_length' => $payloadLength,
            'payload' => $payload,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Validate that payload size is within acceptable bounds.
     * Uses signed comparison to catch negative values from malformed headers.
     */
    private function validatePayloadSize(int $size): bool {
        // On 64-bit PHP, unpack('N', ...) returns values 0..4294967295
        // We cast to signed 32-bit for range checking to catch overflow
        $signedSize = $this->toSigned32($size);
        
        // Reject negative sizes (would indicate corruption/attack)
        if ($signedSize < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check against maximum
        if ($signedSize > $this->maxPayloadSize) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Convert unsigned 32-bit value to signed 32-bit interpretation
     */
    private function toSigned32(int $value): int {
        if ($value >= 0x80000000) {
            return $value - 0x100000000;
        }
        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature
     */
    private function verifyHmac(string $data, string $mac): bool {
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $this->sharedKey, true);
        return hash_equals($expected, $mac);
    }

    /**
     * Dispatch message to appropriate handler
     */
    public function dispatch(array $message): ?array {
        $type = $message['type'];
        if (!isset($this->handlers[$type])) {
            return ['error' => 'Unknown message type'];
        }
        return call_user_func($this->handlers[$type], $message);
    }

    /**
     * Handle store command - payload format: [2-byte name_len][name][data]
     */
    private function handleStore(array $message): ?array {
        $payload = $message['payload'];
        
        if (strlen($payload) < 2) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid store payload'];
        }

        $nameLen = unpack('n', substr($payload, 0, 2))[1];
        
        // Validate name length against payload size
        if ($nameLen + 2 > strlen($payload)) {
            return ['error' => 'Name length exceeds payload'];
        }

        $name = substr($payload, 2, $nameLen);
        $data = substr($payload, 2 + $nameLen);

        // Sanitize filename
        $safeName = $this->sanitizeFilename($name);
        if ($safeName === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid filename'];
        }

        $filePath = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName;
        
        // Verify path is within storage directory
        $dir = dirname($filePath);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0750, true);
        }
        
        $realDir = realpath($dir);
        if ($realDir === false || strpos($realDir, $this->storageDir) !== 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Path violation'];
        }

        file_put_contents($filePath, $data);
        return ['status' => 'stored', 'name' => $safeName, 'size' => strlen($data)];
    }

    /**
     * Handle retrieve command - payload is the filename
     */
    private function handleRetrieve(array $message): ?array {
        $name = $message['payload'];
        $safeName = $this->sanitizeFilename($name);
        if ($safeName === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid filename'];
        }

        $filePath = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName;
        $realPath = realpath($filePath);
        
        if ($realPath === false) {
            return ['error' => 'File not found'];
        }
        
        if (strpos($realPath, $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Access denied'];
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($realPath);
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'data' => $content, 'size' => strlen($content)];
    }

    /**
     * Handle delete command
     */
    private function handleDelete(array $message): ?array {
        $name = $message['payload'];
        $safeName = $this->sanitizeFilename($name);
        if ($safeName === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid filename'];
        }

        $filePath = $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName;
        $realPath = realpath($filePath);
        
        if ($realPath === false) {
            return ['error' => 'File not found'];
        }
        
        if (strpos($realPath, $this->storageDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Access denied'];
        }

        unlink($realPath);
        return ['status' => 'deleted', 'name' => $safeName];
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize filename - allow alphanumeric, dots, hyphens, underscores
     */
    private function sanitizeFilename(string $name): ?string {
        // Remove any path separators
        $name = str_replace(['/', '\\', '\0'], '', $name);
        
        // Must match safe pattern
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,254}$/', $name)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // No double dots
        if (strpos($name, '..') !== false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $name;
    }
}

// Entry point
$protocol = new MessageProtocol('/etc/msgproto/config.json');
$input = file_get_contents('php://input');

if (empty($input)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Empty request']);
    exit;
}

$message = $protocol->parseMessage($input);
if ($message === null) {
    http_response_code(403);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid or unauthorized message']);
    exit;
}

$result = $protocol->dispatch($message);
http_response_code(200);
echo json_encode($result);
